name: wp-messenger-og
description: WpMessenger OG — Next.js WhatsApp Web Management Panel (App Router) + persistent WhatsApp worker. Deploys on Vercel/Netlify (frontend+API) with the worker on Railway/VPS/Docker.

scripts.check: node --check next.config.mjs && node -e "const c=require('./lib/config'); if(!c.firebase.databaseURL) throw new Error('FIREBASE_DATABASE_URL required'); console.log('config OK — Firebase:', c.firebase.databaseURL);"
